description: Fraction addition and multiplication use the usual cross-sum and numerator-product formulas, negation negates the numerator, nonzero inversion swaps coordinates, and a fraction is zero exactly when its numerator is zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rational_representative_formulas
  (p q : Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.FractionRep) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalAdd (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass p)
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass q) =
      Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.fractionAdd p q) ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalMul (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass p)
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass q) =
        Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.fractionMul p q) ∧
      Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalNeg
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass p) =
          Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.fractionNeg p) ∧
        (∀ (hp : p.1 ≠ 0),
            Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalInv
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass p) =
              Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.fractionInv p hp)) ∧
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalValue
                (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalClass p) =
              0 ↔
            p.1 = 0)
